# id: PG-pg-89-balance-perception
# covers: PG 199 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Avarek + Beaks)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest; harness 6a64ee8+ (spawn race filter: the observer wears the Iron Hat, which UWE excludes for Reptiloid/Sharkoloid/Dragoloid)
# design: a fresh neutral observer per point (Hungry Bandit, Drifters, renamed PGW<n>) spawned 100 m from Beaks,
#   who sneaks (detecttime: sneak on). Result = game seconds until seen
#   (timeout 180 s). The observer's skill/gear varies (perception).
#   The observer is killed and moved away after every point.
# verify: seen=1 in most points (seen=0 everywhere: this observer never notices a sneaker, send the .out to
#   the PG agent); stealth: seconds_to_seen grows with Stealth; perception: it shrinks with Perception.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Avarek on
protect Beaks on
health Beaks 100
health Avarek 100
blood Beaks 100%
blood Avarek 100%
hunger Beaks 280
hunger Avarek 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Beaks
pg_statprobe on Beaks
pg_formulas off ~ formulaScaling=0
wake Avarek
pin Avarek ~ pinned
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 60 ~ moved=1
setstat Beaks stealth 70
# --- w1: perception 10, gear none ---
stealth Beaks off
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks -75966.1 327.2 33085.7 ~ moved=1
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Beaks dist 100 count 1 race "!reptiloid|!sharkoloid|!dragoloid|!mechanical|!skeleton|!fishman" ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${OBS} PGW1
pin PGW1 at Beaks dist 100 face Beaks ~ pinned
relation PGW1 0
setstat PGW1 perception 30
pg_statprobe on PGW1
pg_formulas off ~ formulaScaling=0
give PGW1 "Iron Hat" 1
equip PGW1 "Iron Hat"
pg_info PGW1 "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
setstat PGW1 perception 10
pg_clear PGW1 ~ cleared affixes
face PGW1 Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@echo READY
face PGW1 Beaks ~ dist=(\d|([1-9]|1[0-0])\d)\.\d observer_ko=0 los=(0\.[5-9]\d*|1\.0+)
speed 1 hold
stat PGW1 perception ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T detecttime Beaks PGW1 timeout 180 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+ seconds_to_maybe=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,199,perception,10,0,none,w1,detect_observer,180,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Beaks off
pin PGW1 off ~ unpinned
kill PGW1
@until 30 teleport PGW1 Beaks dist 300 ~ moved=1
# --- w2: perception 90, gear none ---
stealth Beaks off
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks -75966.1 327.2 33085.7 ~ moved=1
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Beaks dist 100 count 1 race "!reptiloid|!sharkoloid|!dragoloid|!mechanical|!skeleton|!fishman" ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${OBS} PGW2
pin PGW2 at Beaks dist 100 face Beaks ~ pinned
relation PGW2 0
setstat PGW2 perception 30
pg_statprobe on PGW2
pg_formulas off ~ formulaScaling=0
give PGW2 "Iron Hat" 1
equip PGW2 "Iron Hat"
pg_info PGW2 "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
setstat PGW2 perception 90
pg_clear PGW2 ~ cleared affixes
face PGW2 Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@echo READY
face PGW2 Beaks ~ dist=(\d|([1-9]|1[0-0])\d)\.\d observer_ko=0 los=(0\.[5-9]\d*|1\.0+)
speed 1 hold
stat PGW2 perception ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T detecttime Beaks PGW2 timeout 180 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+ seconds_to_maybe=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,199,perception,90,0,none,w2,detect_observer,180,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Beaks off
pin PGW2 off ~ unpinned
kill PGW2
@until 30 teleport PGW2 Beaks dist 300 ~ moved=1

speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@echo READY
face PGW15 Beaks ~ dist=(\d|([1-9]|1[0-0])\d)\.\d observer_ko=0 los=(0\.[5-9]\d*|1\.0+)
speed 1 hold
stat PGW15 perception ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T detecttime Beaks PGW15 timeout 180 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+ seconds_to_maybe=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,199,perception,75,0,none,w15,detect_observer,180,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Beaks off
pin PGW15 off ~ unpinned
kill PGW15
@until 30 teleport PGW15 Beaks dist 300 ~ moved=1
# --- w16: perception 25, gear own50 ---
stealth Beaks off
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks -75966.1 327.2 33085.7 ~ moved=1
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Beaks dist 100 count 1 race "!reptiloid|!sharkoloid|!dragoloid|!mechanical|!skeleton|!fishman" ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${OBS} PGW16
pin PGW16 at Beaks dist 100 face Beaks ~ pinned
relation PGW16 0
setstat PGW16 perception 30
pg_statprobe on PGW16
pg_formulas off ~ formulaScaling=0
give PGW16 "Iron Hat" 1
equip PGW16 "Iron Hat"
pg_info PGW16 "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
setstat PGW16 perception 25
pg_clear PGW16 ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix PGW16 "Iron Hat" perception 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus PGW16 perception ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
face PGW16 Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@echo READY
face PGW16 Beaks ~ dist=(\d|([1-9]|1[0-0])\d)\.\d observer_ko=0 los=(0\.[5-9]\d*|1\.0+)
speed 1 hold
stat PGW16 perception ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T detecttime Beaks PGW16 timeout 180 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+ seconds_to_maybe=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,199,perception,25,50,own50,w16,detect_observer,180,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Beaks off
pin PGW16 off ~ unpinned
kill PGW16
@until 30 teleport PGW16 Beaks dist 300 ~ moved=1
stealth Beaks off
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
